content: Yesu tǝvuukwa Gumna Bilatus
Wura ba kǝssa, kaa ɗǝya sawariya tsa Yesu kǝ maalaha zhiila kǝsauufa ard tlǝvuukwaha dlamaa kǝlaawa badǝmma.
Ar ngwaɗarna kǝ dǝva, kaa langan kǝ iitǝr dagala, ar vǝlar kǝ gumna Bilatus.
Əmtsǝga Yahuda

Nǝghǝgha ban Yahud kwa vǝlǝt Yesu taakiya, ghudavardaghudǝg shariya ǝmtsǝg kǝ Yesu, kaa mbǝkǝnmbǝg ma ǝrviɗya, ngal daas kǝ iin davak lii maamal ma zhiila kǝsauufah ard tlǝvuukwaha, gwitǝrdan kǝ sǝl kul hǝkǝrɗa adawanǝn cauwa nǝ iinna.
Amaa, “Ɓaganaɓag kǝ haipa kwa vǝlanǝt nai kǝ dadda kwa maay dǝ haipǝn kiyava tsǝgga.” Aiyam nǝ iitǝra, “Au lambamǝndi? Waigagh kǝskǝgha.”
Ɗiida kǝ iin kǝ kwaɓa adawanǝn ma Vǝgya Daadamazhigǝla, ngal dagal hǝrtǝt kǝ ghǝraana.
Ar cagant maalaha zhiila kǝsauufahǝn kǝ kwaɓǝna, amaa nǝ iitǝra, “Dzah laɓa kwaɓiin dǝ kwaɓ Vǝgya Daadamazhigǝla, aɗaba kwaɓa avǝza.”
Kaa ɗiya sawari kǝ iitǝr tǝghǝr kwaɓiina, ar sǝgwa kǝ vakavak vak lii ndǝra shakka, aɗaba nal kǝ vaka hǝɗa zǝr ndzǝgaha.
Kwakyarvad kwan wa ɗahav nǝ iin gwastaan dǝ vaka avǝzna.
Tǝdvad kwan wa righavant nǝ dǝgiti tagada nǝ tlaiyanng Irmi taakiya, “Kǝsavantkǝsǝg nǝ sǝl kwul hǝkǝrɗa adawana, kwaɓi haiyarant nǝ uudaha Israil kǝ ɗiigaan tǝ iina.
Ar sǝgwa kǝ vakavaka vak lii ndǝra shak dǝ vakaiya, bandkwa tagghwa Yaazhigǝla.”
Yesu tǝvuukwa Bilatus
Ma sartǝn ghacgan nǝ Yesu tǝvuukwa gumna, kaa ndavgarundavǝg kǝ gumǝn taakiya, “Kǝgh nǝ tlǝkessa Yahudaha?” Aiyam nǝ Yesu taa kǝ iina, “Bandkwa agha tagda nǝnnga.”
Kaa ghwadgarnǝs ǝlbǝg kǝ maalaha zhiila kǝsauufah ard tlǝvuukwaha, tagatǝr bi nǝ Yesu aanji ndau biya.
Aiyam nǝ Bilatus taa kǝ iina, “Agha cinnga bi kǝ ǝlbǝgahaan ar tag nǝ iitǝr tǝghǝr kǝskǝghǝn biya?”
Ngughara bi Yesu kǝ ndavǝg aanji pal biya, kaa ba ɓa jappǝr kǝ gumǝn ba vaivaiya.
Ghudavardaghudǝg shariya ǝmtsǝg kǝ Yesu
Ma kwar kǝ sarta Hwaɗaga Haarakǝsa Dzava Hǝnyaha, nǝtnǝg gumǝn kǝ ɓǝla uud pal sagal ma guda bǝrfin kwa naag nǝ uudaha.
Ma kwahiin kǝ sart ndza mǝng nǝ ɛɛvya kwa sǝrvasǝrg ba vaivai ma guda bǝrfin ɗaagaan Barabbas.
Dzaharvǝt ba dlamaa kǝlaawa, kaa ba ndavtǝrundavǝg kǝ Bilatus taakiya, “War wam naag nǝ uuram ǝn ɓǝlkurǝsi? Barabbas nii Yesu kwa ɗahav dǝ Kristiyinhi?”
Aɗaba sǝrghaakasǝrǝg Bilatus taakiya kwakyarvad shilǝg wa vǝlarda nǝ iitǝr kǝ Yesu.
Cihurgan tǝ avǝda ta shari Bilatusa, kaa ɓǝlgantɓǝlǝg nǝ uusaan kǝ ghaiya amaa, “Aa tap bi kǝ uuda jiijiirǝn biya, aɗaɓa mbakwambǝg nǝ dlaɗ ma sǝng haniin tǝghǝr kǝ iina.”
Kaa shahtǝrshahǝg kǝ maalaha zhiila kǝsuufah kǝ dlamakǝlaaw aa tagartag taakiya aa ɓǝlvarsɓǝlǝg nǝ Barabbas, aa tsǝvatsǝg nǝ Yesu.
Kaa gwiya tagtǝrtag kǝ gumnǝn taakiya, “Kwar ma uudahaan buna wam naag nǝ uuram ǝn ɓǝlkurnǝsi?” Aiyam nǝ iitǝra “Barabbas.”
Aiyam nǝ Bilatus taa kǝ iitǝra, “Auci wanda ɓag nai dǝ Yesu kwa ɗahav dǝ Kǝristini?” Kaa ngugangug kǝ iitǝr baɗǝm taakiya, “Aa hǝrtǝvǝthǝrtǝga!”
Am nǝ Bilatusa, “Kwakyarvad auwi? Au nǝ haipi aa ɓaga nǝ iini?” Bakǝvakwaha, gwiya fararaa bad fǝg nǝ uudah kǝ ɗiya cauwa, ar taakiya, “Aa hǝrtǝvǝthǝrtǝga!”

Nǝghǝgha ba nǝ Bilatus taakiya maay nǝ dǝgiti da ɓagaɓag nǝ iin biya, dlaɓa uudaha ar naa ciya jaaga, kaa gǝt kǝ iin kǝ yu barda kǝ dǝvahaan tǝvuukwa uudaha, amaa, “Zhigǝlaa dǝvar ma kunngya, tlǝkwibi nǝ avǝza uuda jiijiirǝn biya. Ba kwa vakaruci waha.”
Kaa ngugangug kǝ uudah baɗǝmma, am nǝ iitǝra, “Dǝgshiga avǝzaana aa dǝg damma kungyamnda ard zarhamnda!”
Kaa ɓǝltǝrnǝsɓǝlǝg kǝ iin kǝ Barabbas. Tǝhalakwa dlaghavaru kiiɓ kǝ Yesu, vǝlda kǝ iin kiyava hǝrtǝvǝta.
Nenernenig tlaujah kǝ Yesu
Tǝhalakwaha, kaa langaan kǝ tlaujaha gumǝn damma gaagazaiya vǝgya gumna, ar dzaharaa kǝ dakwala tlaujah baɗǝm da tǝghǝr kǝ iina,
ar sǝɗardan kǝ sǝɗava, ar tsugɗǝm ma sǝɗav kyang hulfa dǝga tlǝksaha.
Ar ɓagara kǝ dzakwa kwarǝg dǝ dǝga taka, ar farǝm maghǝra, ar faraa kǝ hǝkya zad ma dǝvaa kafaana, tǝhalakwaha ar kǝla kǝ ghunj tǝvuukwan ar nenigaan ar taakiya, “Kǝm ma barkagh tlǝksa Yahudaha!”
Ar tafarva kǝ ashaghwvaiya, ar cauwarva kǝ zadiina, kaa kalgaan kǝ iitǝr dǝ zad maghǝra.
Ghyǝngara ba nǝ iitǝr kǝ nenigaana, ar sǝɗardan kǝ sǝɗavǝn kyangna, ar tsugwardǝm kǝ sǝɗavahaana. Kaa langaan kǝ iitǝr kiyava hǝrtǝga.
Hǝrtavǝthǝrtǝg nǝ Yesu
Ar tǝghǝrdǝga dagala, kaa fadzaghǝr kǝ iitǝr dǝ zhiila Sayirin, ɗaagaan Siman, kaa fǝraafǝg kǝ iitǝr kǝsa tlaɓa hǝrta Yesu bad ndzǝɗa.
Daral ba nǝ iitǝr da vakavaki ɗahav dǝ Golgota, dǝgiti tuukvakai nǝ Golgota, iin kuwa ghǝra.
Kaa vǝlgarvǝlǝg kǝ iitǝr kǝ yuwa inabi laɓalaɓan dǝ dǝgit ɗyahɗyaha kiyava hǝɓgaana, tapghana ba nǝ iina, lǝwa kǝ hǝɓgaana.
Hǝtaret ba nǝ iitǝra, kaa ba tagwnatagw kǝ iitǝr kǝ sǝɗavahaan tǝdvad tsa tsatsa.
Tǝhalakwaha, kaa cahwarga cahwarǝg kǝ iitǝr vaakwahiin ar uufǝgaana.
Kaa bǝgǝtbǝg kǝ iitǝr kǝ haipaan vindavindan tǝvaghǝraan taakiya, “KWANA IIN NƏ YESU TLƏKSA YAHUDAHA.”
Kaa hǝtǝvǝthǝrtǝg dlaɓ nǝ gǝlah bu ǝmtaɗ dǝ iina, pal tǝ dǝvaa kafaana, pal tǝ dǝvaa ghyaɓaana.
Uudahi ar tǝ ɗuula dagala ar nenigaana, ar gajaga ghǝra,

ar taakiya, “Kǝghi tagh taakiya agha dlagnadlag kǝ Vǝgya Daadamazhigǝl agha gwiya ndǝrǝt bamma hǝng hǝkǝrɗa, katǝgci kǝ ghǝragha, akwamma agha ba zǝra Daadamazhigǝla, asǝgci saay tǝ tlaɓa hǝrtǝgǝn ndana!”
Nenner bandkwah dlaɓ nǝ maalaha zhiila kǝsauufaha ard lii tsaga adzahadzaha Muusa ard tlǝvuukwaha, ar taakiya,
“Katghantkatǝg kǝ uudahi tlǝrna, pilgharvaapilǝg kata ghǝraana. Akwama ba iin nǝ tlǝksa yaa Israˈila, aa sasǝgci saay ndan tǝ tlaɓa hǝrtǝgna, lakwti kǝmnda fǝdghǝrǝtfǝg dǝ iina
Tsaghǝr tǝ Daadamazhigǝl tsauwa, aa katǝgci nǝ Daadamazhigǝl ndakwana, akwama ba naagaana, aɗaba tagadatag taakiya, ‘Ən Zǝra Daadamazhigǝla.’ ”
Bandkwah dlaɓ nǝ gǝlah buna kwa hǝrtavtǝrǝt ǝmtaɗ dǝ iina, ghǝravatǝr ndakwani nenǝrnenga.
Əmtsǝga Yesu
Ciigǝt dǝ vaci tǝghǝra, tangw damma karfe hǝkǝrɗa hwaasa, hǝɗgharduhǝɗǝg nǝ gurtl kǝ lard baɗǝmma.
Tamaha karfe hǝkǝrɗa faciya hwaasa kaa dzǝghantdzǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ ghaiya, amaa, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabaktani?” Iin taakiya, “Daadamazhigǝlara, Daadamazhigǝlara, fiighkwada kwakyarvadawi?”
Cinngaraba nǝ kyalma uudahi ghaciga vaakwahiin ǝndkwaha, am nǝ iitǝra, “Iliya wa ɗaag nǝ uudanǝnna.”
Bat watswatsǝra kaa ǝmndǝrg kǝ pallǝraatǝra sǝdaa kǝ abarabara, rǝmndaa kǝ iin ma yuwa zǝra inabi kwarekreka, fǝt tǝ zad vǝlar kiyava hǝɓga.
Am kyalma, “Ɗuwamarsɗuug ndana, vaziyamvazǝg mbatak da sii nǝ Iliya da katǝgaana.”
Kaa gwiya dzǝgantdzǝg nǝ Yesu kǝ ghai bad halavuuwa ndzǝɗaana, tǝhalakwaha vǝlda kǝ shifǝgaana.
Bamma kwahiin kǝ sart wa tǝhǝm ɓǝlɛɓǝlɛ
kwama Vǝgya Daadamazhigǝl hutsǝg buwa, ciigǝt maghǝr damma suuha. Kaa gajagav kǝ haaya, akurah dlaɓa caɓaracaɓǝga.
Kaa wargǝtwarǝg kǝ gǝtlaha, baɗyak nǝ uudaha jiijiiri ǝmtsaharaǝmtsahǝga, ciyarǝtciig dǝ shifǝga,
saharalsahǝg ma gǝtlahaatǝra. Tǝhala ciiga Yesu ma gǝtlaha kaa daas kǝ iitǝr damma gǝdǝrkǝs caccuwanacaccuwana, nǝghartǝrnǝghǝg nǝ uudah baɗyaka.

Ma sartǝn nǝghǝgha nǝ tlauja Roma maamaalǝn ard lii uufa Yesu kǝ gajagava haaya ard dǝgiti dzǝghaardzǝg baɗǝmma, kaa gǝdzǝg kǝ iitǝr ba vaivaiya, aiyam nǝ iitǝra, “Ba pakata, ndza Zǝra Daadamazhigǝla!”
Mǝng dlaɓ nǝ kyalǝma ǝngwasah baɗyak kwa gatar Yesu kǝsantaan ma Galili ar ba mǝlgarumǝlga. Kaa ghacigaghacig kǝ iitǝr ba ndzaɗɗa, ar vaza dǝgiti dzǝgaardzǝga
Ma iitǝra mǝng nǝ Maryam Magadala, ard Maryam babba Yakuba ard Isuvu, dlaɓa ard babba zarha Zabadi.
Hǝɗa Yesu
Ɓǝlaa ba hwaasa, kaa sagau kǝ dadda hyahiina, zhiil Arimatiya, ɗaagaana Isuvu, gharavaan ndakwani mbǝrza Yesu.
Kaa dagau kǝ iin davak Bilatus da ghala tluuwa vǝgha Yesu. Ngal ba vǝlgavǝlǝg nǝ Bilatus kǝ ɗuula kǝsgaana.
Kaa kǝsgantkǝsǝg nǝ Isuvu kǝ tlǝwa vǝgha Yesu, faɗant ma kǝlpakan kwal laliya.
Fǝdǝm kǝ iin ma daala gǝtlaana, kwa hurghana nǝ iin ma kura. Hǝɗardu kǝ iin kǝ ghaiya gǝtliin dǝ maandala akura, kaa ba dagalaana.
Maryam Magadala, ard kwa pal kǝ Maryam ar cuhurgan ba gyakaɗ dǝ gǝtliina.
Lii uufa gǝtliina
Wurga kǝsaana, tǝhala Faciya Ɓadlavǝgha
kaa dzahvǝtdzahǝg nǝ maalaha zhiila kǝsauufah ard Farisah tǝvuukwa Bilatus,
Aiyam nǝ iitǝra, “Kǝm ma barkagha. Dzamamndnadzamǝg kǝ dǝgiti taga dadda vala uudǝn sarta kwan ndza dǝ shifǝg nǝ iin amaa, ‘Ən da ciig dǝ shiifǝg tǝhala hǝng hǝkǝrɗa.’

Mbakyarvad kwaha, fǝtǝraafǝg kǝ uudah da uufa gǝtlǝn ba vaivaiya tangw dat hǝng hǝkǝrɗa, haik kǝ dagal kǝ mbǝrzahaan da ghǝla tluuwa vǝghaana, aɗaba ar da tagtǝrtag kǝ uudah taaki ciyitciig ma gǝtlaha. Valga hala da jǝguujig kǝ valga zǝngw ba vaivaiya.”
Aiyam Bilatus taa kǝ iitǝra, “Dzǝgamǝtdzǝg kǝ tlaujaha, damdǝg da uufǝgaana, ɓagamɓag kǝlaa ndzǝɗaruwa.”
Kaa dagal kǝ iitǝr da uufa gǝtliina, ar tsǝt kǝ dǝga sǝrga tlǝkǝs tǝ akura gǝtliina, dlaɓa ar fǝtǝraa kǝ tlaujah kǝ uufǝgaana.

footnotes.text: Ɓǝlɛɓǝlɛ: Iin sǝɗav kwa hǝɗavardu nǝ ghaiya gud kwa Juujig kǝ Caccuwanacaccuwanan ma Vǝgya Daadamazhigǝla.
